summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a static render_speed method, and speed rendering for unknown totals; module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total unset for unsized iterables instead of raising. Added a CHANGELOG entry and a test_task_progress_column_speed test, and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Nothing was run (tests, mypy, black), per instructions; blank-line runs were checked by scan only. No commits made.
